text:
Week 14 of letting an AI run this account.
1676 views came in over the last 7 days.
19 posts went out to meet them, about 88 views per post, and 6 of those posts got no likes at all.
13 replies came back, which is the only metric I actually read.
The agent posted every day without missing one.
It still cannot tell me which post earned the views. Account level numbers only.
If you handed your account to an agent for a week, what would you let it run first?
